name: NotAction-Deny narrows a full '*' rule grant -> downgraded, NEVER blocked-by-deny
note: Allow Action:'*' on Resource:'*' with a same-policy Deny that uses NotAction:iam:CreateAccessKey. The Deny denies everything EXCEPT iam:CreateAccessKey, so that action stays ALLOWED - the '*' grant is narrowed, not blocked. The allows(actiongroup:*) edge must stay reachable (downgraded to context-required), with the Deny on its own denies edge. Companion to the Allow s3:* case; asserts the same fix holds for a bare '*' grant token.
